summary: CSV export to per-customer EUR totals, with quoted fields and currency conversion
instruction: Finance needs paid revenue per customer in EUR. Write totals.js so that `node totals.js orders.csv` prints a JSON object mapping each customer name to the sum of `amount` over rows whose status is `paid`, converted to EUR with the rates in rates.json (a rate is how many EUR one unit of that currency is worth), rounded to 2 decimals, with keys sorted alphabetically. The CSV comes from an Excel export, so expect quoted fields, commas inside quotes, doubled quotes and Windows line endings. No npm packages.
